title: The class-restricted full cohomological-dimension datum
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $(p_0,a,q,k_0,k)$ with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Fix a prime $\ell\ne p_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a chosen uniformizer $\varpi_E$ of its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, and an integer $n\geq1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E$, with its finite discrete coefficient convention [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Y$ and $\overline X$ be finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $p:\overline X\to Y$ be a proper finite-type morphism over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism].

For any scheme $T$, use the small pro-étale site $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and its constant-$A$ module category $\mathsf M_T=\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $D_T=D(\mathsf M_T)$ and $\iota_T\mathcal F=\mathcal F[0]$ for the object represented by the complex with $\mathcal F$ in degree zero and zero elsewhere, as in [def-weil-full-cohomological-dimension]. Use the finite-level total derived direct images of [def-weil-derived-direct-image] and the cohomology-sheaf functors $\mathcal H_T^r:D_T\to\mathsf M_T$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves].

A sheaf $\mathcal F\in\mathsf M_{\overline X}$ belongs to the coefficient class of [def-sf-fullcd-used-class] if there exist a sheaf $\mathcal G$ of modules over the constant ring $A$ on $\overline X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and an isomorphism of $A$-module sheaves $\nu_{\overline X}^*\mathcal G\cong\mathcal F$. Here $\nu_{\overline X}$ is the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Membership means existence of a witness, with no chosen witness as additional data; no constructibility condition is imposed on $\mathcal G$.

For $c\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$, define $\operatorname{FullCD}_{\mathrm{cls}}(p,A;c)$ to be the conjunction of the following two clauses.

1. For every $\mathcal F\in\mathsf M_{\overline X}$ in this class and every integer $r>c$,
$$
 \mathcal H_Y^r\bigl(Rp_*(\iota_{\overline X}\mathcal F)\bigr)=0
 \quad\text{in }\mathsf M_Y.
$$
2. For every object $v:V\to Y$ of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, form the fibre product $\overline X_V=\overline X\times_YV$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections $g_V:\overline X_V\to\overline X$ and $p_V:\overline X_V\to V$. For every $\mathcal F\in\mathsf M_{\overline X}$ in this class and every integer $r>c$,
$$
 \mathcal H_V^r\bigl(R(p_V)_*(\iota_{\overline X_V}(g_V^*\mathcal F))\bigr)=0
 \quad\text{in }\mathsf M_V.
$$
Here $g_V^*\mathcal F=\mathcal F|_{\overline X_V}$ is the module-sheaf pullback of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], namely inverse image followed by extension of scalars from $g_V^{-1}A_{\overline X}$ to $A_{\overline X_V}$. Both clauses use the same coefficient ring $A$ and the same bound $c$. The quantifier in clause 2 is over sheaves on the original source $\overline X$, followed by pullback; it is not a quantifier over all sheaves on $\overline X_V$. There is no finite-type requirement on $V$ or $\overline X_V$. This defines the class form of the two clauses of $\operatorname{FullCD}(p,A;c)$ [def-weil-full-cohomological-dimension] by restricting their original-source sheaf quantifier to the essential image just specified.

lean.statement: def sfClassFullCohomologicalDimension {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (c : ℕ) : Prop
lean.note: §1(B): the now-published HasCohomologicalDimensionLEOnEtaleOrigin has the two required vanishing clauses, but its FullCohomologicalDimension module imports legacy pro-etale Derived.Comparison and ExceptionalAdjoint modules, incompatible with the recorded intrinsic finite-coefficient import closure. This module renders those same two clauses using the compatible finite-coefficient operations and canonical chosen pullbacks. It uses the essential-image definition of etale origin, without the false explanatory identification of all such sheaves with constructible sheaves.

blueprint_update.statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an integer
$n\geq1$, $A=A_{E,n}$ with the
finite-torsion
coefficient convention, $k=\Fbar$, finite-type $k$-schemes $Y$ and
$\overline X$, and a proper
finite-type $k$-morphism $p:\overline X\to Y$. Use the
small pro-étale sites, the
derived direct image $Rp_*$, and
the cohomology-sheaf
functor $\mathcal H^r$. Call a sheaf $\mathcal F$ of $A$-modules on
$\overline X_{\Proet}$ a *coefficient sheaf of the blueprint's class*
if it is of étale origin,
$\mathcal F\cong\nu_{\overline X}^*\mathcal G$ for a sheaf $\mathcal G$
of $A$-modules on $\overline X_{\Et}$ in the sense of
[def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], the comparison morphism
$\nu_{\overline X}$ being that of
[def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]; this is the class of
[def-sf-fullcd-used-class], read on the source $\overline X$, and by
[lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin] it is also the class of
constructible pro-étale coefficient sheaves. For an integer
$c\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$, write
$\operatorname{FullCD}_{\mathrm{cls}}(p,A;c)$ if

$$
\mathcal H^r(Rp_*\mathcal F)=0\qquad(r\in\mathbf Z,\ r>c)
$$

for every coefficient sheaf $\mathcal F$ of that class on
$\overline X_{\Proet}$, and if, for every object $V\to Y$ of
$Y_{\Proet}$ and every such $\mathcal F$, the base change
$p_V:\overline X\times_YV\to V$ of $p$ satisfies

$$
\mathcal H^r\bigl(R(p_V)_*(\mathcal F|_{\overline X\times_YV})\bigr)=0
\qquad(r\in\mathbf Z,\ r>c),
$$

the restriction $\mathcal F|_{\overline X\times_YV}$ being the pullback
along the projection $\overline X\times_YV\to\overline X$, which is again
of étale origin on the base-changed source by
[lem-sf-fullcd-class-restriction].
